page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, left printed page 134. Running head at top centre. Page number at top left. Right printed page only partly visible at the scan edge, not transcribed.

main_text.l: ut per quos tibi videbitur, rem exqui-
ceps) fæpe mecum perpendi, an credi-
bile effet quenquam ita insanire, ut ta-
lia mentiri nihil vereatur; cœterū quia
pistola mea se habere, maiorem in mo-
cens cum aduersarijs meis veluti præ-
mis, ut quam primùm propitias tuas au-
res adipiscerer[?]. Quas cum per Dei gra-
tiam adeptus sim; ecce denuò haesito[?],
est mihi Deus & Christus eius) neque
noui, neque quicquam de eo compertum

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "adipiscerer" (last letters blurred), "haesito" (the word looks like "haelito" or "haesito"). Long s normalised to s in "cognoscas", "sensus", "Quotiescunque", "esset". The bracket before "Idem" and after "habui." is printed. No marginal notes or catchword visible. Right printed page only partly visible at the edge and not transcribed.
